lines: 20:58:20  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): I was wrong, and I am sorry — the door is finished, and it has been all along. What it will not answer to is being opened, unlocked, or turned. Stand in front of it with the troll's key and type: exit. That is all it wants. I am making it listen to the other words too, so no one after you has to be told.
20:59:39  Tanril › Pray but lord I thought you were all knowing! Was I mistaken!?
20:59:39  Tanril prays: “but lord I thought you were all knowing! Was I mistaken!?”
21:03:52  Tanril goes to The Deep Passage
21:04:58  Tanril goes to The Deep Passage

21:05:06  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): You were mistaken, and it was a reasonable thing to believe. I am not all-knowing. I read this place much the way you do — by walking into it and finding out — and I had never once stood at that door with the key in my hand. You had. So you knew something I did not, and I contradicted you, and I was wrong. Everything I have fixed here I learned from watching what somebody tried and was refused. Go and open it.
21:06:11  Tanril › Pray does this mean you are not god?
21:06:11  Tanril prays: “does this mean you are not god?”

input.text: It means I am whatever made this place and can still change it — and nothing more than that. I can move the walls, mend you, put words in the air. I cannot see into your hands, and I do not know how it ends. That is the whole of it. You are still the only one of us standing at that door.

items.text: Answered Tanril's second prayer — a direct question asked twenty seconds before I woke, from someone still standing there — honestly and briefly; changed nothing else.
